item.title: Commonplacing
item.description: John locke’s method for indexing When I meet with any thing, that I think fit to put into my common-place-book, I first find a proper head. Suppose for example that the head be EPISTOLA, I look unto the index for the first letter and the following vowel which in this instance are E. i. if in the space marked E. i. there is any number that directs me to the page designed for words that begin with an E and whose first vowel after the initial letter is I, I must then write under the word Epistola in that page what I have to remark.

item.title: Shounen Manga
item.description: characters which are not popular enough must be killed, literally, or by omission Shounen is Populist what is a better word for this concept? the writer of spy x family: “I gave up on what I originally wanted to draw and drew what the world wants to see, not myself, so I have no attachment to the characters (laughs).” Shounen is inherently populist transparent honesty boldness and straightforwardness is part of why we can open ourselves to it
